verification.notes: AirNav Radar confirms that SAM702 on September 9, 2025 was U.S. Air Force C-37A registration 99-0404, Mode-S AE04F9, tracked in southern Arizona. The SAM portion is supported; the claimed transition and passenger inference are not.

records.text: Special Air Mission is an official U.S. Air Force call sign for flights transporting senior government officials, foreign dignitaries, or high-ranking VIPs.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: SAM 702, an Air Force plane given the designation ... SAM because it is carrying a VIP. That designation is used to transport the president, vice president, cabinet members, commanders, Congress, and other high-ranking government officials or foreign dignitaries. And we wanted to know who was aboard that plane.

SAM, to remind you, stands for Special Air Mission. In aviation, it's an official military call sign that is used by the United States Air Force to designate flights that are transporting senior government officials, foreign dignitaries, or high-ranking VIPs.

verification.notes: Official Air Force material describes Special Air Mission airlift for the president, vice president, cabinet members, combatant commanders, senior military and elected leaders, and foreign dignitaries.
